title: fix: #5614 prevent silent data loss when saving legacy encodings
issueTitle: Saving a file in a legacy encoding silently replaces unrepresentable characters with "?"
why: The bug only shows up in the bytes written to disk after saving in a legacy encoding, which needs the encoding menu, file saving and reading the file outside the editor, and the report only suggests a possible fix, so it never says what warning or prompt the fixed app shows.
